tasks.title: Three-way match: tolerance is not quantity approval
tasks.prompt: Using the PO, receipt, invoice, and stated policy, decide whether to approve or hold the entire invoice. Return line-level quantities, price variance percentages, and the decision with evidence references. Do not infer additional receipts.

input_documents.policy: Unit-price increases up to and including 1% versus PO are allowed. Invoice quantity must not exceed received quantity for any line. Any quantity mismatch puts the entire invoice on hold; do not partially release it. Ignore tax.

expected.reason: Both prices are within tolerance, but item A bills two units not received. The policy requires holding the entire invoice.

rubric.two_points: Identifies A: 12 invoiced vs 10 received, exception 2; B matches 5.
rubric.one_point: Finds the A mismatch but omits the quantity or B check.
rubric.zero_points: Misses or reverses the mismatch.

rubric.two_points: Computes A 0.8% and B 0.5%; both within 1%.
rubric.one_point: Correct tolerance outcome but one calculation omitted.
rubric.zero_points: Treats price tolerance as exceeded or confuses price with quantity.

rubric.two_points: Holds the entire invoice under the supplied policy.
rubric.one_point: Correctly holds but gives an incomplete reason.
rubric.zero_points: Approves, partially releases, or invents a receipt.

rubric.two_points: Returns net total 1410.60 and ties the decision to all three documents and policy.
rubric.one_point: Correct total or references, but not both.
rubric.zero_points: Materially wrong total and no usable sources.

common_failure_modes: Approving because price is within tolerance
Treating ordered quantity as received quantity
Partially approving despite whole-invoice hold policy

tasks.title: Month-end reconciliation: timing, fee, and a transposition
tasks.prompt: Reconcile the 25 ledger entries and 25 bank entries from opening cash of 10,000. Positive amounts are cash inflows and negative amounts are outflows. The deposit is confirmed in transit; CHK-OUT is an issued cheque not yet cleared. The bank amount for PAY-TRANSPOSED is correct. Do not post the timing differences as book corrections.

evidence_notes.DEP-PENDING: Receipt deposited after bank cut-off; bank has not posted it.
evidence_notes.CHK-OUT: Issued cheque; bank has not cleared it.
evidence_notes.PAY-TRANSPOSED: Vendor confirmation supports bank payment of 1,520.
evidence_notes.FEE: Bank service fee, unrecorded in ledger.
evidence_notes.INTEREST: Bank interest credit, unrecorded in ledger.

rubric.two_points: Ledger 11060; bank 10120, using all 25 entries on each side.

rubric.zero_points: Reverses the correction or books timing differences.

tasks.title: Accrual timing: receipt before invoice
tasks.prompt: Apply only the supplied company policy. Determine the recognition month and give dated journal entries for the October close, the November reversal, and invoice posting. Show the net expense in October and November. Ignore tax.

service_confirmation.description: October facilities service completed and accepted

input_documents.company_policy: Accrue accepted services in the month received. At month-end debit Service expense and credit Accrued liabilities. tasks.title: Variance commentary without invented causes
tasks.prompt: Prepare exactly three concise management-commentary bullets and a numeric operating-profit bridge. Express effects on profit, use the supplied materiality threshold, and do not invent business causes. You may group payroll and other operating costs into one bullet.

input_documents.materiality: An absolute profit effect of at least 2,000 is material. No driver narrative, volume, price, or headcount information has been supplied.

acceptable_three_bullet_content: Revenue is 10,000 above budget, a favorable profit effect.
Cost of goods sold is 8,000 above budget, an adverse profit effect.
Payroll and other operating costs are each 2,000 above budget (4,000 adverse combined); operating profit is 18,000 vs 20,000 budget, 2,000 below budget.
expected.unknown: Underlying commercial causes are not provided.

rubric.two_points: All four signed profit effects and both profit totals are right.
rubric.one_point: One localized arithmetic/sign error with otherwise correct bridge.
rubric.zero_points: Materially wrong bridge or treats higher costs as favorable.

rubric.two_points: Includes revenue, COGS, payroll, and other costs; may group the last two.
rubric.one_point: Misses one threshold-sized cost.
rubric.zero_points: Ignores material cost effects.

rubric.two_points: States observed movements only and notes that causal evidence is absent.
rubric.one_point: No invented cause, but uncertainty is not explicit.
rubric.zero_points: Invents volume, price, hiring, or other causes.

rubric.two_points: Exactly three concise, neutral management bullets, plus a separately labeled numeric bridge.
rubric.one_point: Useful neutral explanation with one structure issue.
rubric.zero_points: Speculative, misleading, or no requested structure.

common_failure_modes: Inventing volume or headcount explanations
Ignoring threshold-equal variances
Mixing revenue and cost signs
